description: This file contains a PHP class 'Filter' which is part of the OpenCart admin controller for managing product filters. It includes methods for listing, form handling, saving, and retrieving filter data, with functionality for filtering, sorting, pagination, and rendering views related to catalog filters.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing catalog filters in the OpenCart admin area, including listing, form editing, saving, and filtering functionality.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the filter list view with filters, breadcrumbs, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of filters in a view, used for AJAX listing.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered and sorted list of filters with pagination, returns HTML view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving filter data, including validation and permissions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates a list of filters based on request parameters for AJAX.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filters, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides filter suggestions based on user input for autocomplete functionality, returning JSON data.
